title: Issue 02 — remove skip/global multi-host upgrades entirely
policy: Remove named skip/global upgrades from EVERY region host. No single-home keep. Do not touch Grace of the elves (GOTE), Dark Facet of Grace (GOTE enchantment), or Herb patches (N) rows.

perUpgrade.name: Hoardstalker ring
perUpgrade.reason: A4 not relevant — DG convenience tele; not a region-gated major unlock

perUpgrade.name: Learn broad arrow / bolt fletching (300 Slayer points)
perUpgrade.reason: A5 global Slayer Rewards Learn — not region-locked

perUpgrade.name: Learn quicker killing blows (400 Slayer points)
perUpgrade.reason: A6 not relevant — global Slayer Rewards Learn

perUpgrade.name: Games necklace teleport package
perUpgrade.reason: A8 not relevant — craftable jewelry tele package

perUpgrade.name: Ring of duelling
perUpgrade.reason: A11 not relevant — craftable jewelry tele

perUpgrade.name: Cremation ability unlock
perUpgrade.reason: A12 skip — rare ability drop, not region planning value

perUpgrade.name: Ore box tier upgrades
perUpgrade.reason: A13 not region locked — metal-bank capacity ladder is global

perUpgrade.name: Herb patch network (global herb-run map)
perUpgrade.reason: A2 replace with per-region Herb patches (N) rows — do not remove those

perUpgrade.name: GOTE + Dark Facet of Grace + ancient elven ritual shard sustain
perUpgrade.reason: B2 do not mega-chain; keep split GOTE / Dark Facet rows only

perUpgrade.name: GOTE gather + porter sustain checklist
perUpgrade.reason: B4 residual checklist — do not chain GOTE/porter supply; keep base GOTE / Dark Facet rows

perUpgrade.name: Signs of the porter (Divination supply system)
perUpgrade.reason: F5 no region need — energy ladder is multi-region residual

perUpgrade.name: Fury shark outfit + Bait and Switch Fishing stack
perUpgrade.reason: B10 ignore combo — keep separate Fury / Bait and Switch rows

notes.opSchema: removeUpgrade { regionId, name, reason } — one op per host (apply-region-patches.mjs). No removeUpgradeByNameAllHosts in applier; expanded explicitly.
